subject: radiology
title: Bosniak Classification of Renal Cysts and Renal Mass Imaging

steps.title: Bosniak grades cyst complexity
steps.tx: **Bosniak classification** sorts cystic renal masses by wall, septa, calcification and enhancing soft tissue into categories that carry rising cancer risk. Category 1 is a simple cyst with an imperceptible wall and water density, needing no follow up. Category 4 holds an enhancing solid nodule inside the cyst and is cancer until removed. The middle categories trade imaging features against surveillance intervals.
steps.say: Bosniak classification sorts cystic renal masses by wall, septa, calcification and enhancing tissue into categories with rising cancer risk. Category one is a simple cyst needing no follow up. Category four holds an enhancing solid nodule and is cancer until removed. Middle categories trade features against surveillance intervals.

steps.title: Simple cyst rules on ultrasound
steps.tx: **Simple renal cyst** on ultrasound is round, anechoic, with an imperceptible wall, posterior enhancement and no internal echoes or septa. Meeting every rule ends the workup at any age. A single thin septum or fine calcification still fits the minimally complex group that needs no follow up in most adults, while thick septa, debris or Doppler flow inside pushes the lesion into CT or MRI characterisation.
steps.say: Simple renal cyst on ultrasound is round, echo free, with an imperceptible wall, posterior enhancement and no septa. Meeting every rule ends the workup. Thick septa, debris or Doppler flow inside pushes the lesion into CT or MRI characterisation instead.

steps.title: Enhancement separates cyst from tumour
steps.tx: **Enhancement** on CT means the lesion density rises at least 15 to 20 Hounsfield units after contrast, proving vascular tissue rather than fluid. A Bosniak 3 cyst shows enhancing thick walls or septa without a discrete nodule, landing near a fifty percent cancer rate and usually going to surgery or ablation. Pseudoenhancement can fake a 10 unit rise in small cysts surrounded by enhancing kidney, so MRI settles lesions under 2 cm.
steps.say: Enhancement on CT means density rises at least fifteen to twenty Hounsfield units after contrast, proving vascular tissue rather than fluid. A Bosniak three cyst shows enhancing thick walls without a nodule, landing near fifty percent cancer risk. MRI settles small lesions where pseudoenhancement fakes a rise.

steps.title: Hyperdense cysts and the 2F watch
steps.tx: **Hyperdense cyst** holds old blood or protein, reading 20 to 90 Hounsfield units before contrast but never enhancing after it. A smooth round hyperdense lesion under 3 cm fully inside the kidney fits category 2 and needs nothing. Category 2F lesions carry more septa, thicker calcification or size over 3 cm, earning CT or MRI surveillance at six and twelve months then yearly to prove stability.
steps.say: Hyperdense cyst holds old blood or protein, reading twenty to ninety units before contrast but never enhancing after it. Category 2F lesions carry more septa or size over three centimetres, earning surveillance at six and twelve months then yearly to prove stability.

steps.title: Solid renal mass pathways
steps.tx: **Solid renal mass** imaging asks fat first: macroscopic fat inside the mass names angiomyolipoma, a benign tumour of fat, vessels and muscle that bleeds when over 4 cm or aneurysmal. No fat means renal cell carcinoma until proven otherwise, with clear cell type enhancing avidly and often heterogeneously. Oncocytoma mimics cancer on every sequence including its spoke wheel arteries and central scar, so most solid masses still end in histology.
steps.say: Solid renal mass imaging asks fat first: macroscopic fat names angiomyolipoma, which bleeds when over four centimetres. No fat means renal cell carcinoma until proven otherwise. Oncocytoma mimics cancer on every sequence, so most solid masses without fat still end in histology.

steps.title: Staging looks at veins and nodes
steps.tx: **Renal tumour staging** on CT hunts tumour thrombus climbing the renal vein into the inferior vena cava, which changes the operation from simple nephrectomy to vascular control and possible bypass. Chest CT follows because lung is the commonest metastatic site, and bone scan waits for pain or raised alkaline phosphatase. The kidney outline image set used in teaching pairs these anatomy points with the cyst categories in one view.
steps.say: Renal tumour staging hunts tumour thrombus climbing the renal vein into the vena cava, which changes the operation completely. Chest CT follows because lung is the commonest metastatic site. Bone scan waits for pain or raised alkaline phosphatase rather than running routinely.

steps.title: Bosniak in polycystic kidneys
steps.tx: **Polycystic kidneys** break Bosniak scoring because hundreds of cysts overlap, bleed and calcify without cancer. New pain or fever in polycystic disease more often means cyst haemorrhage or infection than malignancy. A dominant mass that enhances solidly, grows fast or invades the vein still earns the cancer pathway. Transplant and dialysis kidneys develop acquired cystic disease with a real carcinoma risk, so their new solid nodules are never dismissed as just another cyst.
steps.say: Polycystic kidneys break Bosniak scoring because hundreds of cysts overlap, bleed and calcify without cancer. New pain more often means cyst haemorrhage or infection. A dominant solid enhancing mass still earns the cancer pathway, and dialysis kidneys with new solid nodules are never dismissed.

steps.title: Reporting language that drives care
steps.tx: **Bosniak reporting** must name the category, the features earning it, comparison with priors and the exact follow up interval or surgical referral. Incidental simple cysts should be called benign in plain words so patients are not recalled needlessly. Growth of a cyst alone does not upgrade it, because benign cysts enlarge; new enhancing nodules, thickening walls or multiplying septa are the changes that move a lesion up a category.
